why_this_matters: Day 146 sits in Phase 8 (SQL + Databases), whose goal is: Query relational databases fluently and pass SQL interviews. Today's core material - Detecting duplicates with window functions, Standardising categories with CASE and mapping, Trimming and casing text - is the vocabulary the rest of the phase is built on. Learners who skip the concept and jump to copying code usually stall two weeks later; the goal here is that you can explain what you did, not just that it ran.

code.heading: Build the model
code.code:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers

# create an input layer
input_layer = tf.keras.layers.Input(shape=(28, 28, 1)) # 28x28 pixel images with a single color channel

# CNN model building

model = tf.keras.Sequential([
    input_layer, # input layer
    layers.Conv2D(filters=10, kernel_size=(3, 3), activation='relu'), # convolutional layer
    # filter is the number of filters we want to apply
    # kernel is the size of window/filter moving over the image
    layers.Conv2D(filters=10, kernel_size=(3, 3),  activation='relu'), # convolutional layer
    layers.MaxPooling2D(), # pooling layer

    layers.Conv2D(filters=10, kernel_size=(3, 3), activation='relu'), # convolutional layer
    layers.Conv2D(filters=10, kernel_size=(3, 3), activation='relu'), # convolutional layer
    layers.MaxPooling2D(), # pooling layer

    layers.Flatten(), # flatten layer
    layers.Dense(10, activation='softmax') # output layer # why did we add 10?
])

common_mistakes.mistake: Watching the lecture without running the repository notebook.
common_mistakes.why: Recognition is not recall: code that looked obvious fails the moment you type it yourself.
common_mistakes.fix: For every topic today, run the linked notebook cell, then retype it from memory in your own file.

common_mistakes.mistake: Using Detecting duplicates with window functions on data whose types or shape you have not printed.
common_mistakes.why: Most failures in this topic are input problems (dtype, shape, missing values) rather than logic errors.
common_mistakes.fix: Print type and shape immediately before the operation; keep that habit for all 275 days.

debugging.symptom: The linked notebook cell raises ModuleNotFoundError or ImportError.
debugging.cause: Wrong kernel/environment selected, or the library is not installed in the active environment.
debugging.fix: Print sys.executable in the notebook and install into that environment (Day 4).

debugging.symptom: Your output differs from the recording even though the code looks identical.
debugging.cause: Library version differences, a changed default argument, or unseeded randomness.
debugging.fix: Pin versions (requirements.txt), set a random seed, and compare dtypes and shapes, not just values (Day 5).
